subject: gk
question:
Identify the correct match. 

A) Pension to retired government employees - Revenue Receipt

B) Purchase of Machinery in Railways - Capital Expenditure
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only B.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The purchase of machinery in** Railways** is a **Capital Expenditure** as it involves the acquisition of a **fixed asset** that will be used over a period of time to generate revenue for the **Railways.**
 
• **Capital Expenditure **refers to the expenditure incurred on acquiring or improving fixed assets such as **land, buildings, machinery, **etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue Expenditure** refers to the expenditure incurred on the day-to-day running of the business or government.
 
• They are essentially the same as **operating expenses **(OPEX) because they comprise all of the costs necessary to cover the** business's present operating costs.**
 
• Pension to retired government employees is a Revenue Expenditure as it is a recurring expense for the government.
